title: Kiosk WVSU LC
summary: Event management kiosk system built for WVSU LC. Features event scheduling, attendance tracking, and real-time status updates.
description: A full-featured event management kiosk system designed for West Visayas State University - Lambunao Campus. Built with TypeScript and Next.js, it handles event scheduling, attendee registration, QR code check-ins, and real-time status dashboards. Deployed on Vercel for scalability.

title: Flappy Clone
summary: A browser-based Flappy Bird clone built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Arcade-style gameplay with retro visuals.
description: A faithful recreation of the classic Flappy Bird game built entirely with vanilla web technologies. Features smooth physics, collision detection, score tracking, and retro-styled visuals. Deployed and playable directly in the browser via Vercel.

title: SaligAI
summary: AI-powered assistant designed to support persons with disabilities (PWD) through voice commands, accessibility features, and intelligent task automation.
description: SaligAI is an accessibility-focused AI assistant built with TypeScript that helps persons with disabilities navigate daily tasks through voice commands, screen reader optimization, and intelligent automation. Features include voice-activated controls, text-to-speech responses, and customizable accessibility profiles.

title: ColorPointer
summary: Real-time hand gesture color changer using computer vision. Control your screen colors with hand movements via webcam.
description: An interactive computer vision application that tracks hand gestures through the webcam to dynamically change screen colors in real-time. Built with TypeScript and MediaPipe hand tracking, it detects finger positions and gestures to control a virtual color palette.
features: Real-time hand gesture tracking via webcam

title: Chess Game
summary: Full chess game implementation with move validation, AI opponent, and clean TypeScript architecture.
description: A complete chess game built from scratch in TypeScript featuring full move validation (including castling, en passant, and pawn promotion), an AI opponent with minimax algorithm, and a clean terminal-based interface. Demonstrates strong algorithmic thinking and game logic implementation.
features: Castling, en passant, and pawn promotion

title: Teachable Dino
summary: An AI-powered 8-bit retro platformer runner controlled using trained machine learning webcam gesture inputs.
description: Designed and built an interactive retro game environment integrated with Google's Teachable Machine API. Users can train a custom image classification model in their browser and control the game character's actions hands-free using real-time webcam gestures.

title: Portfolio Website
summary: This portfolio site — a vanilla HTML/CSS/JS static site with dark/light theme, animations, and JSON-driven content.
description: A premium, hand-crafted portfolio website built with zero frameworks — just vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Features include dark/light theme toggle with localStorage persistence, scroll-triggered reveal animations, JSON-driven project and blog data, a contact form with validation, and fully responsive design.
